issues.title: BLU-012 Teach Mode capture session lifecycle

criteria.requirement: Cancel discards; restart does not resume; denied apps not captured

tests.name: ac1 cancel drops captured steps and restart stays off

criteria.requirement: Happy path, malformed input, timeout, cancellation, permission denied, offline and restart cases where applicable

tests.name: ac2 timeout expiry refuses observation and stops capture
ac2 offline refusal is explicit and stays off
ac2 mid-session policy tightening denies the next observation
ac2 malformed capture results are refused without retention
ac2 restart yields a clean session state

criteria.requirement: No unintended egress, secret retention, or unsafe auto-execution

tests.name: ac3 secret-bearing input discarded and draft cannot execute

criteria.requirement: flutter analyze and relevant tests pass; PR includes commands and evidence
criteria.reason: flutter analyze and the relevant suites run on every PR CI; native macOS TCC validation remains the documented manual lane.
